Name: AT Pet Puffins
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Adds 16 different colored puffins as textures for your pet cat!
Adds the 5 different colored puffins starmops created to replace the chickens in their mod, along with 11 new different colors!
To change the texture of your cat, just buy the scissors from Robin and use it on your cat.
